issues.description: PATCH and DELETE use flat `/tracker/phases/:id` instead of plan-nested `/tracker/projects/:projectId/phases/:id` (POST is correctly nested)
DELIVERABLE scenario 'same phase name in two different projects' has no test coverage
DELIVERABLE scenario 'tasks ordered C, A, B appear in that order after delete' is not asserted on activity payload released itemIds (only sequential positions are checked)

strengths: Delete-to-no-phase correctly nulls phase_id only, preserves project_id, and repositions items after existing no-phase bucket tail via positionBetween (tracker-phases.ts:100-142)
Delete runs atomically in one transaction: release items, soft-delete phase, single recordTrackerActivity, single publishEvent (tracker-phases.ts:331-368)
Released tasks do not touch version or updated_at; per-item updates set only phase_id and position
parseDateRange imported from tracker-item-parsers.js (sync, correct) — not reimplemented locally
POST assigns end-of-list position via max(position)+positionBetween; workspace/project membership validated before writes
PATCH uses optimistic locking with 409 on stale version mirroring tracker-projects precedent
All 14 unit tests pass; commit message matches feat(tracker): … format; only scoped files changed

issues.description: Quality bar must-not-have violated: releasePhaseItemsToNoPhase is a local duplicate; plan refactor step required extracting shared release helper with T9 — not done
Order-preservation test mock returns phaseItems in array insertion order without simulating ORDER BY position ASC, so the C/A/B ordering guarantee is not actually exercised
No test for PATCH with startDate only and no endDate (DELIVERABLE accepts partial explicit dates)
Inverted-date POST test checks insertedValues.length but not mockTransaction.not.toHaveBeenCalled (plan example asserted pre-transaction validation)
